subject: Request: BCP runbook snapshot, RTO/RPO evidence & SIG/CAIQ items
messages:
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@pioneerbank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: BCP evidence request — timeline by EOD Friday?

Hi Markus,

Following up from our security intake call this morning — Pioneer is moving the Redwood evaluation into the final procurement window. Our InfoSec team needs a short package to close out BCP/DR items in the SIG/CAIQ. Specifically we need: 

- A current copy of the runbook (production) showing failover steps for the text-generation service and the Dedicated pool routing;
- RTO / RPO matrices for hosted API and Dedicated (per-region items) and a short note on how warm KV cache affects RTO estimates;
- Recent test evidence (last 12 months) for a full failover or restore (logs, timestamps) or an attestation if full test details are restricted;
- Any SOC 2 mapping rows that call out recovery and system availability controls.

Can you provide a concise artifact packet and a signed attestation by EOD Friday (2027-04-04)? If anything is sensitive we can accept an executive-signed attestation and a secure Drive link for logs.

I attached our redlined SIG (high-priority sections highlighted). Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Jamie Ortiz
Senior Infosec Analyst | Pioneer Bank
Attachment: pioneer_redlined_SIG_20270401.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@pioneerbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BCP evidence request — timeline by EOD Friday?

Jamie — thanks for the clear list and the redline. We can get you a compact packet that should satisfy the SIG/CAIQ reviewers and your procurement team.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope artifacts correctly:
- Do you need the runbook pages that show automated orchestration steps only, or the full runbook with team contact rosters and escalation matrix?
- Is the RTO/RPO required for both Hosted API *and* Dedicated (reserved capacity) for all regions, or just US prod?
- For test evidence, would a signed attestation plus redacted test logs be acceptable, or do you require full trace logs with timestamps?

Plan from our side: Marissa will assemble a runbook snapshot (PDF) and an RTO/RPO matrix. I will prepare a one-page attestation that we can sign and return. We can also provide a short sample of warm-KV cache traces (redacted). We'll upload artifacts to a secure Drive folder and grant Pioneer access.

Preliminary attachments (attached): redwood_bcp_runbook_snapshot_2027-04-01.pdf; rpo_attestation_2027-03-31.pdf

We aim to have the packet and a signed attestation to you by EOD Friday (2027-04-04). If Pioneer needs the full runbook for legal review we'll coordinate with security to provide a redacted copy via an access-controlled link.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Reliability & Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_bcp_runbook_snapshot_2027-04-01.pdf
Attachment: rpo_attestation_2027-03-31.pdf

From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@pioneerbank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Pioneer Bank Security Team <security@pioneerbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BCP evidence request — timeline by EOD Friday?

Thanks Markus — quick clarifications from our side: 
- We need the full runbook (redacted contacts are fine) because legal wants to confirm the escalation flow and vendor handoffs;
- RTO/RPO for US prod and EU prod only (we can skip APAC for now);
- For test evidence, an attestation + redacted logs is acceptable *if* attestation calls out the exact test date, scope, and the person who signed off.

Also — the redlined SIG contains a set of CAIQ questions about data replication and standby behavior for reserved pools. Can Redwood confirm whether Dedicated pools have cross-zone warm-cache priming vs on-demand cold starts? That detail is critical for our RTO calculation.

If you can include an explicit sentence in the attestation like: "At time of last planned failover test (2026-11-18) observed RTO for the Hosted text-generation API was 2.3 minutes (95th percentile) and Dedicated pool failover completed within 5 minutes due to KV cache reseeding" — that would close a lot of our review items.

We can fast-track signatures internally if you provide a DocuSign-ready attestation.

Jamie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@pioneerbank.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BCP evidence request — timeline by EOD Friday?

Jamie — looping in the artifacts and next steps. Per Markus' plan we prepared a compact package and a DocuSign-ready attestation. Links and notes below: 

1) Drive folder (Pioneer access granted): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/PIONEER/BCP-ARTIFACTS
   - redwood_full_runbook_prod_redacted_20270404.pdf (contains escalation flow; Cc lists redacted)
   - redwood_bcp_runbook_snapshot_2027-04-01.pdf (technical steps & orchestration playbook)
   - rpo_attestation_2027-03-31.pdf (signed by Head of Ops)
   - warm_cache_trace_excerpt_20261118_redacted.log (sample of KV reseed traces)
   - redlined_SIG_response_draft.docx (we filled rows for recovery/availability sections)

2) Attestation (DocuSign-ready): we added the explicit line you requested referencing the November 18 test. DocuSign envelope created — URL will be emailed to your security mailbox; if you prefer we can post it to the Drive folder.

3) Quick answers to the Dedicated pool question: Dedicated pools in US/EU use a warm-KV priming approach for pre-warmed standby nodes in the same region (cross-zone priority), which reduces practical failover RTO compared to cold starts. We added a short technical appendix in the runbook snapshot that explains the reseed window and observed 95th percentile numbers from our last test.

4) SIG/CAIQ: we've pre-populated the recovery sections in the redlined SIG response. If you want us to complete the full SIG online we can nominate a Redwood SME to finish the questionnaire — Marissa can lead that.

Proposed next steps: 
- You (Pioneer) sign the DocuSign attestation (we'll countersign);
- We finish the SIG online and upload the final copy to the Drive folder;
- If legal needs the unredacted runbook we'll provide it under an NDA + controlled access.

If anything is missing or you want additional metrics (latency histograms for warm reseed), let us know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
